name: How do I choose the right features for my custom spa?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right features for my custom spa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right features depends on your intended use and desired experience. Consider factors like hydrotherapy (jet types, placement, and power), water temperature options, seating arrangements, lighting (LED, fiber optic), sound systems, automation controls, and eco-friendly heating solutions. We guide you through available options, explaining their benefits to help you select features that enhance your relaxation and wellness goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select features based on intended use, considering hydrotherapy options, seating, lighting, sound, automation, and heating to match your relaxation goals.
